name: Binder clip
summary: A folded strip of springy steel clamps a thick stack of paper, and two wire handles flip back to pry it open.

parts.name: Steel body
parts.role: A triangle of springy black steel whose two edges press together.

parts.name: Wire handle
parts.role: A wire loop that swings out to lever one edge open.

parts.name: Wire handle
parts.role: The second wire loop, on the other edge.
